description: This file is a shell script for managing DHCP on a network interface, including starting and stopping DHCP, updating WAN settings, and handling redirection flags.

methods.name: do_stop_dhcp
methods.description: Stops DHCP client by killing its process and removing PID file.

methods.name: do_start_dhcp
methods.description: Starts DHCP client on specified interface unless already running.

methods.name: do_wan_update
methods.description: Updates WAN IP address and subnet, and manages redirection flags.
